title: Trying to Get Girlfriend Arrested Totally Backfires
description:
On January 15th, 2024, officers responded to a dispute between two women over their relationship. One of the women told the officers that the other had been yelling, screaming, and calling her a whore because she had talked to and looked at other women. Both of them were highly intoxicated and had very slurred speech, which made it difficult for the officers to understand what they were saying. One of the officers tried to explain the situation to the woman's mother. Here's what the other woman told the officer regarding the altercation. One of the officers recognized a woman from a previous encounter. She continued to rant about her girlfriend in front of the officers. Based on the information provided by the women and the evidence, the officers decided to arrest one of them. The woman continued to kick the officers violently. Shortly after, she was transported to the hospital for a checkup. She didn’t even spare the hospital staff from her abusive behaviour. The woman was charged with aggravated assault, battery against a household member and disorderly conduct.

Police Insider provides unbiased and authentic footage of incidents captured on body cams. We believe this footage can be used as an educational guide for viewers. 

We only provide unique and original content that hasn’t been covered before on YouTube.

The raw footage for the videos on this channel have been obtained directly from the respective Police Departments. We as a media company have the right to use it commercially. Most incidents may require a fee associated with the request and take several days to process.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
